title: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
script:
Elorian Glimpse just beat GPT-six Astra.
This new AI model solves scientific charts better than OpenAI's flagship.
Glimpse uses the image itself as a workspace for its logical deductions.
It costs sixty cents per million input tokens and three dollars for output.
Elorian's evaluations show it wins at reasoning through complex scientific data.
It also delivers more accurate captions for short-form videos than GPT-six.
This follows OpenAI's two thousand twenty-five launch of similar reasoning in its o-series.
Elorian plans to expand these spatial reasoning capabilities for industrial use cases.
Would you trust it with your data?
